bundle.format: Deterministic sorted ustar+gzip, uid/gid/mtime zero, file mode 0644, directory mode 0755. Exact payload bytes and complete embedded .git files/indexes preserved; original filesystem metadata is not represented.

parent_report_pin_validation.disposition: Terminal CLI summary changed after historical index finalization; immutable index and current summary bytes both preserved. Authoritative detailed reports match. No historical pin rewritten.

index_preservation.method: Private evidence index based on HEAD; explicit raw blob insertion only. Shared index integration may add owned evidence entries only, preserving all unrelated entries, flags and staged changes.

excluded_raw_paths.disposition: Leave every original synthetic fixture and embedded Git history in place byte-for-byte, under the existing tmp ignore rule. No ignore edits or gitlinks. All originals represented by the verified bundle and per-member manifest.

verification_limits: Artifact hash, byte, archive and Git-scope checks only; no production/test/research/build/cloud execution or credential/key/remote payload retrieval.
